name: Cadwell Park Circuit
description: The mini Nurburgring in the Lincolnshire Wolds. Narrow, steep and twisty, with the famous Mountain where cars go light over the top.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (336 of 1396 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
